_comment: Every tool that declares reach anyone, with the reason it is safe: the in-code guard it relies on (callers list, presence proof, own-scope check, held at the Gate), or read-only. A tool with a mutating verb in its name needs a reason that names a guard; read-only does not count. PENDING reasons are tracked and shrink. test/reach-anyone.test.js fails on an anyone with no entry.

planner.calendar.create.reason: guard: an agent may only ask for an invite; attendees mean invites, which hold at the Gate for the person (returns held); its own planner event is the agent's own item

planner.calendar.sync.reason: read-only toward the person's calendars: it copies connected Google calendars into the planner's own copy

planner.delete.reason: guard: owns() in core/planner refuses an agent any item it did not add (an agent may change, finish, snooze, dismiss or delete only its own items; a calendar copy is nobody's to add)

watchers.test.reason: guard: a dry run files nothing and runs inside the wall (no sockets of its own; GET and HEAD only, to hosts the watcher declared; a credential only through the person's per-watcher grant; ask() capped per day); an agent may not dry-run on a real event (refused in code), and watchers.create still needs the person's words and the card's hash
